definitions.explanation: the act of loading goods or cargo onto a vehicle, ship, or container

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷積|にづ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Loading onto the truck has begun.

examples.japanese: {荷積|にづ}み⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The loading work is scheduled to finish by noon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{船舶|せんぱく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷積|にづ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昼夜|ちゅうや}→昼夜：12993_chuuya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the port, cargo is loaded onto large ships around the clock.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (cargo/freight) and {積|づ}み (loading/stacking, from ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧). Refers specifically to the process of loading goods onto a transport vehicle. The opposite operation is {荷降|にお}ろし (unloading).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷積|にづ}み⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: loading work
- {荷積|にづ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out loading
- {荷積|にづ}み⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: loading area
- ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{荷積|にづ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to load onto a truck

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積|つ}み{込|こ}み→積み込み：09264_tsumikomi⟧: loading, stowing — similar but emphasizes putting items into a container or vehicle
- {荷降|にお}ろし: unloading — the reverse process of removing cargo
- ⟦{積載|せきさい}→積載：15883_sekisai⟧: loading, carrying — a more formal/technical term for carrying a load
